review.note: Retracted in M22: the election of 10 October 1999, at which the Socialists were returned one seat short of an absolute majority. The atlas can argue nothing from it: the euro was joined nine months before, Macau was handed over on terms fixed in 1987, and the government it made resigned after the local defeat of December 2001 — which the atlas now holds, wired to the election of 2002. What is still missing is the resignation itself; write that and this record has somewhere to go.
